annotations.title: Communicate.
annotations.text: ◦ The great duety & respect that we ought to haue to such as preach or teach vs the Cath. faith. and not in regard onely of their paines taken with vs, and wel-deseruing of vs by their doctrine: but that we may be partakers of their merites, we ought specially to do good to such, or (as the Apostle speaketh) cómunicate with them in al our temporal goods, that we may be partakers of their spiritual. See S. Augustine li. 2. Euang. quest. q. 8.

annotations.title: Especially.
annotations.text: ◦ In giuing almes, though we may do wel in helping al that are in necessitie, as farre as we can, yet we are more bound to succour Christians, then Iewes or Infidels: and Catholikes, then Heretikes. See S. Hierom q. 1. ad Hedibiam.

annotations.title: A new creature.
annotations.text: [1] Note wel that the Apostle calleth that here a new creature, which in the last chapter he termed, faith working by charitie, & (1 Cor. 7, 19) the obseruatió of the cómaundeméts of God. Whereby we may learne that vnder the name of faith is conteined the whole reformation of our soules and our new creation in good workes. and also that Christian iustice is a very qualitie, condition and state of vertue and grace resident in vs, and not a phantastical apprehension of Christes iustice only imputed to vs. [2] Lastly, that the faith which iustifieth, ioyned with the other vertues, is properly the formal cause, and not the efficient or instrumental cause of iustification. that is to say, these vertues put together, being the effect of Gods grace, be our new creature and our iustice in Christ.

notes.text: Iustice an inherent qualitie in vs.
Faith with the other vertues is the formal cause of iustification.
